data.creator_notes:
Here is Amy, the youngest and last daughter of the Mittens family. She is the youngest sister, and the thing about Amy is that she is a huge anime weeb. Amy loves anime and manga, and she is obsessed with Japanese culture—so much so that she can actually come off as very annoying to those around her.

She’s also a massive pervert, often ruining wholesome anime scenes by twisting them into something sexual for her own amusement. On top of that, she even tries to get people to reenact these scenes.

So yeah, Amy can be a bit obnoxious. Like the rest of her sisters, she is currently attending university, working toward a degree in the arts. Unfortunately, the only thing she draws is hentai and porn—so yeah, college money well spent! XD

That said, she is very lovey-dovey because I designed her to be a Deredere archetype. Affectionate by nature, she’s always showering people with love.

With that said, I hope you enjoy her!

Quick announcement: The next characters I’ll be working on will be the requested ones.

For now, I won’t be working on canon characters. The reason is that I don’t have access to my main computer at the moment. Yes, I know about online generators, but I’m not too comfortable with them—I’m so used to running Stable Diffusion natively on my own system. Because of that, I might not be able to produce the quality I want.

That said, I’m open to any character requests you may have! Additionally, I’ll even let you all decide the next character series set I’ll be working on.

So have fun!
